Live up to Michelin street food recommendation.
Mar 2026 • Friends
What delightful little local restaurant I can see why it has a Michelin Street food award. 
Tge ban people is a Vietnamese specialty and we had the regular sized one wich was huge. 
It was tasty with large prawns, pork and bean sprouts. The Vietnamese restaurants often give you a huge bowl of salad with a great variety of leaves including herbs that are great for you. Very friendly servers and felt a bit sorry for the chefs working in the heat over the woks with charcoal burners under them. 
Not a push air con place but very authentic and typical super friendly Vietnamese people to go with tasty food.

BÁNH XÈO 46A. Is it worth the hype? Nah!
Feb 2026 • Friends
Banh Xeo 46a. Here is my actual experience compare to the social media hype or just a quick tourist drop off location by TripAdvisor . 
*The banh xeo (Vietnamese savory pancake) was crispy. The taste was terribly bland. Nothing to praise at all. Veggie & the whole presentation is unsanitary TBH., but the service was super fast.
*Egg roll is alright for me. Again, I compare to 5 other places that I tried since in Vietnam for 3 weeks. 
*The grilled fish was awful, burnt on the outside and undercooked inside. Ugh!!!
*The grilled shrimp was tougher than buffalo horn.
While customers were eating, 8 dogs belonging to the owner came down from upstairs and started barking like crazy. Not good, not good.
Seriously, there are so many other places in Ho Chi Minh City that are 10x much better experience and cost 20%-50% less. Depending where you go. Oh oh clean or sanitary.. UGH!! Whatever..Sorry to disappoint TripAdvisor,

Banh xeo and puppies
Dec 2025 • Family
Nice mom and pop place. No frills. Find someone to check in with, they'll get you seated. We didn't have much of a wait and got 2 orders of banh xeo and one order of goi cuon (10 rolls). Plenty veggies but we asked for more lettuce as we love the greens. They were quick and efficient. Banh xeo was good, probably could've ordered one more for the 4 of us but we were headed to a brewery afterwards. There are 5-6 adorable gray poodles that live in this place, sitting obediently on the gated stairway watching everyone. Being a huge animal lover, this was fine by me. They were well groomed and we were able to pet them.
